title: Is the guidance on Paid Plan Tiers still current?

question.author: member_219
question.body: I found an older discussion about paid plan tiers. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: The Business plan includes 10 TB shared across the organization, team folders, granular roles, and SSO integration, at $14.99 per user per month. Enterprise plans receive custom storage sizes and a dedicated support engineer. All paid plans include 180 days of file version history and a 90-day recycle bin, compared with 30 days on the free plan. The Plus plan includes 2 TB of storage for individuals at $9.99 per month. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
